changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestcoding AS SELECT dtc.id, dtc.diagnostic_test_id, dtc.code_type, dtc.code_id, dtc.created_by, dtc.created_date, dtc.last_modified_by, dtc.last_modified_date FROM public.diagnostic_test_coding dtc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestcoding TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestcoding FROM report_user;
